snippet.title: Crooked Cooks - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4288270/Crooked_Cooks/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=demo_promo&utm_content=video_description

Cook by day, crime by night — sometimes both at once!

Crooked Cooks is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op game where you and your crew run a restaurant as a front for the Boss' criminal jobs.

Cook, serve customers, take on shady missions, and try to keep the restaurant running through the chaos.

Wishlist Crooked Cooks on Steam!
